era: Britannica.com 2019 (Arquivo.pt captures of the home page Jan, Jul and Dec 2019, article pages Mar-Nov 2019 and search results Mar-Nov 2019): navy header with the Encyclopaedia Britannica wordmark, a square 'Search Britannica...' field with a search button, orange START YOUR FREE TRIAL / Subscribe button and Log In; a trending-topics row under the header; home with Trending Articles, Trending Lists, Trending Quizzes, 'Explore Encyclopedia Britannica' and 'Encyclopedia Britannica by Category'; articles with a left table of contents, Top Questions, fact box, Cite / Share / Feedback and the breadcrumb; plain search results with title and summary. The site is behind Cloudflare bot protection, so the inventory was taken read-only in the user's Chrome with the inventory collector.
